name: Nipa Palm
subtitle: Healing Sap
mechanism: Aura (AuraPlant). Every pulse_interval s, every damaged plant within aura_radius (itself included) regains heal_amount HP (PlantBase.heal, never above full), so plants scorched by a Cao Lau Cook's 60-damage coal spill recover. Keeps healing between waves.

clipAnnotations.idle: Fronds sway; the fruit head breathes.
clipAnnotations.attack: Fronds lift and spread as the sap flows.
clipAnnotations.die: Squash and shrink into the mud.
